title.name: SH1FT-W
title.sub: Home Assistant integrations and Mac apps. Everything here started as something I needed at home: no cloud accounts, no tracking, plain files you can read.

items.title: Casora
items.text: A calm, room-by-room dashboard for Home Assistant, with a visual studio to shape each room.

items.title: FLODE
items.text: See and edit your automations and scripts as a flow, saved as plain Home Assistant YAML.

items.title: Pulse
items.text: Notices when battery sensors in Home Assistant go quiet, without polling them.

items.title: JBL Bar
items.text: JBL soundbars with JBL One, fully local in Home Assistant: fast, complete, no cloud.

items.title: PS5
items.text: Your PlayStation 5 in Home Assistant: status, wake and rest mode, fully local without cloud or MQTT.

items.title: HeliaLux
items.text: The Juwel HeliaLux SmartControl in Home Assistant, local, robust and without surprises.

items.title: Fluval
items.text: Fluval Bluetooth LEDs in Home Assistant, fully local: Reef and Plant 4.0, the Nanos, Plant PRO and more.

items.title: Chihiros
items.text: Chihiros LEDs, Commander and dosing pump in Home Assistant, fully local over Bluetooth proxies.

mac.title: AgentBar
mac.text: Your Claude Code agents in the macOS menu bar, with a tiny animated office.

mac.title: ShareMount
mac.text: Network shares that reconnect by themselves, right from the menu bar.

soon.title: Evenlight
soon.text: Adaptive lighting done right: follows the sun, gets the most out of every lamp, wakes you with a sunrise and leaves alone what you set by hand.

soon.title: Reolink Plus
soon.text: Live video for Reolink cameras that have no stream of their own, attached right to the Reolink device.

soon.title: Pflanzenmonitor Plus
soon.text: Companion to Plant Monitor: learns each plant's watering cycle, predicts the next watering and suggests thresholds with AI.

soon.title: UniFi Network Plus
soon.text: Adds what the UniFi Network app shows and Home Assistant doesn't: throughput, clients, internet quality and speed tests.

soon.title: UniFi UNAS
soon.text: UniFi NAS in Home Assistant: storage, drives, data scrubs and health, locally through UniFi OS and UniFi Drive.

soon.title: Ring Plus
soon.text: Extra controls for the Ring Intercom, added to the official Ring integration: door opener, Ring-to-Open, unlock duration, restart.

soon.title: De'Longhi
soon.text: Your De'Longhi coffee machine in Home Assistant with just a smart plug: learns every program, counts every cup, knows when it needs care.
